title: Cursor blog highlights
description: A 'Recent highlights' title, four small paper post cards in a row (a muted 'date · category' line, the post title, and a byline with a 24px round avatar) that darken one step on hover, and an orange link to all posts. On phones the cards scroll sideways with the next one peeking in.
notes: four posts fill the desktop row; empty avatars are muted circles
